strings.language.title: Language
strings.language.intro: Choose the language of the add-in's panels. Names, values and messages that come from Fusion Manage and Fusion are shown as they are.
strings.language.label: Display language
strings.language.name: Language name
strings.language.created_next: Open the folder and translate the text on the right of each line in this file. Keep the names on the left and the {placeholders} as they are. Then choose Reload to use it.
strings.language.add_intro: If your language is not supported out of the box in the Display language list, you can create your own.
strings.language.how_create: Enter a language code (for example de) and the name of the language in that language (for example Deutsch), then choose Create. This makes a file that starts with the English text.
strings.language.how_translate: Choose Open folder and open the new file in a text editor. Translate the text on the right of each line. Keep the names on the left and any {placeholders} as they are, and save the file.
strings.language.how_reload: Choose Reload. Your language appears in the list under Your languages, and the panels change to it when you choose it.
strings.language.how_scope: The file is kept on this computer only. Names, values and messages that come from Fusion Manage and Fusion are never translated.
strings.language.share_hint: The languages you made. Each is Local (only on this computer) until it is in your hub's Configuration File, then it is Shared. Save & Publish puts all of them in the file, and members receive them when they read or update it. To stop sharing one, delete it and publish again.
strings.language.share_hint_member: The languages you made. They are on this computer, and only you can use them. Only a Hub Admin can publish languages to the hub, so ask one to share yours with everyone.
strings.language.saved_text: Your language settings are saved on this computer.

strings.language.restart_banner: The ribbon buttons and panel titles change after the restart.
